subject.title: feat(android): add cron job management controls

question: Should this PR land with `.github/workflows/android-cron-management-proof.yml` as a maintained workflow, or should that proof-only automation be removed or folded into existing Android lanes before merge?
rationale: The workflow is not needed for runtime behavior, but merging it makes a feature-specific proof lane part of the repository automation surface.

options.title: Remove or fold into existing lanes
options.body: Treat the workflow as contributor proof scaffolding and keep durable Android proof inside existing maintained CI or release-proof workflows.

options.title: Land as a maintained proof workflow
options.body: Accept ongoing ownership of a dedicated Android cron workflow with branch-specific push triggers and manual dispatch.

recommendation.title: Remove or fold into existing lanes
recommendation.body: Treat the workflow as contributor proof scaffolding and keep durable Android proof inside existing maintained CI or release-proof workflows.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal is broad ownership of the Android runtime/settings and cron helper surfaces touched by the PR.
